Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
By the way, have you ever had a New Year's dream？
I... never have, actually.
I dreamed I went on a date with you, ▲小早川＊▲...
Aw, really？ I didn't have one, so I was hoping I could at least hear about yours.
Well then, make sure you have one next year, okay？
You just come right out and say stuff like that... Hey, do you think you had it... because you like me？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Don't you think this cold... is just ridiculous？
You say that, but it is winter, you know.
Who decided winter had to be cold？ That's tyranny. There's nothing good about it being cold at all.
Isn't it romantic when it snows？
We can warm each other up, right？
What, playing the romantic？ ...I guess that's not bad. ...Still, I hate the cold.
What, you wanna hold hands or something？ Not that I mind. Here, give me your hand.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Did you know there are plum blossoms blooming near our way to school？ Just one side street over.
Plum blossoms, huh... I didn't notice at all.
So, pop quiz. Do you know what plum blossoms mean in the language of flowers？
A noble heart!
Plums are plum delicious!
Oh, not bad. ...And here I only just found out by chance yesterday.
Anyway, even with the plums blooming, it's still freezing. Brr, so cold, so cold!
Kobayakawa
Those cherry trees behind the school. I saw them from a window the other day, and they say they're at their peak now.
Right. Nobody but students goes back there, so it's a great secret spot for viewing.
So anyway, a friend from my class wants to see what you're like, and asked if we'd all go blossom viewing together.
No way, I want it just us two!
I could stop by and say hi, at least.
"No way"？ ...What are you throwing a tantrum for？ Acting like a kid, old man. Hehe!
Oh, look who's being shy. Well, if you actually came, I'd be pretty embarrassed too.
You're yawning a lot... Am I boring you？
Kobayakawa
No, I'm just sleepy. You know, since it's gotten warmer lately, it's hard waking up in the morning, too.
True. I've been getting sleepy in class a lot, too.
Right？ I wonder why we get so sleepy like this.
"Spring sleep knows no dawn," indeed.
Because ▲小早川＊▲ keeps showing up in my dreams...
That's not even a reason... And what's with the "indeed"？ ...Quit looking so smug!
That's your excuse？ Doesn't apply to me, though. ...'Cause you only show up in mine once in a while.
Kobayakawa
Oh, I didn't know there was a flower bed here. These tiny little flowers are so cute...
So even ▲小早川＊▲ likes flowers？
You could leave out the "even"! ...Okay then, what kind of flower do you think suits me？
A bright, glamorous flower!
A pure, modest flower, maybe？
Huh, that's kind of surprising. Flashy, huh... You mean that in a good way, right？
It bugs me how unsure you sound... Still, it actually doesn't feel half bad.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. I was looking at the calendar and realized something huge.
What is it...? Wait, I didn't forget we had a date or anything, did I？
If you did that, I'd kick you on the spot. No, it's just... the year is already half over. ...Don't you think that went by way too fast？
Just means it's been a really full year！
We still have half left, right？
Oh, so that's why... Wait, so it's your fault it flew by so fast？ Want me to kick you anyway？
Huh. Gotta love that positive thinking. Man, I really need to take a page from your book！
Kobayakawa
I always think summer break is gonna be long, but it flies by in no time.
Still haven't had enough fun？
Well, yeah... More importantly, what about your homework？
Already turned it in, of course！
Don't tell me, ▲小早川＊▲...
Aw, man. If you hadn't, I could've made fun of you. And here I actually buckled down and finished mine for once.
Too bad for you, mine's all done. Don't tell me YOU haven't finished yours？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Are you ready for the uniform switch？ Crazy how it's already time for winter uniforms.
Yeah... Guess it's really fall now.
Why're you staring off into space？ What's on your mind？
Girls start covering up more in the fall！
Just missing our summer memories.
You're the worst！ It'd at least be a little cute if you said "my girlfriend" instead of "girls"！
Yeah, I get that... Still, I'm sure we'll make plenty of new memories this fall, too. ...As long as I'm with you.
Kobayakawa
Now that we've switched uniforms, it's officially fall, okay？ Am I right？
The calendar says it's fall, too.
Then why is it so hot out？ This weather is seriously weird. Global warming is no joke.
You're exaggerating. It'll work itself out！
Going green all of a sudden？
That kind of attitude is what ruins the environment, you know. ...Though personally, I don't hate that side of you.
Nope. I'm gonna blast the A/C at full power, so you can sweat it out and save energy for the both of us.
Kobayakawa
In the old lunar calendar, October is called Kannazuki, right？
The "month without gods," right？
Oh, so you knew that. Are you good at classical Japanese？
Ari, ori, haberi, imasokari！
I just know a lot of trivia.
Ah, yeah, that! Imasokari. I memorized it without even knowing what it means, though. Is that okay？
Even if you're bad at school, knowing stuff like that makes you look smart, huh. Maybe I should try that...
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. I thought it felt cold this morning, and the puddle out front was frozen.
It got cold all of a sudden. Winter's really here.
I'm not big on the cold, but isn't that crunch when you step on thin ice kinda fun？
Isn't that a bit childish？
I know just what you mean！
Who cares. That's not childish, it's called being innocent！
Right～？ It's just one of those silly little pleasures.
Kobayakawa
You know all those animal shows on TV？ I feel like they're kind of lazy.
Lazy？
Like how they think if they just show some baby animals, everyone'll fawn all over them.
Well, it gets ratings...
So you don't watch them, ▲小早川＊▲？
Man, adults sure have it rough. My dad's always stressing over ratings too.
I never said that. I hate to admit it, but baby animals aren't fair.
They make even my heart melt a little.
Kobayakawa
What's your favorite animal again？ I don't think I've ever asked you.
Now that you mention it, maybe not？
Tell me, just for the record. Call it boyfriend research.
I like dogs.
I like cats.
Hmm. Well, to each their own. It's not like I hate dogs or anything, either.
Really？ I hope you're not just saying that for me.
Okay then, next time we spot a cat, I'll let you pet its fluffy fur too.
Kobayakawa
My parents are planning an outing, and it's to the zoo... What do you think？
Hmm, sounds nice to me. Going with your family should be fun, right？
Oh？ What's fun about it？
How they recreate habitats！
You can pet the animals！
Wait, so it's educational？ Well, it'd be bad if my brother ended up hating school like me.
I see... That does sound like a nice family time. Guess I'll tag along.
Kobayakawa
I keep getting called on in English class lately. The teacher definitely has it out for me！
Did something happen with the English teacher？
I got praised once for my pronunciation, so now they make me read the textbook every class. Just 'cause I listen to Western music doesn't mean I know English.
Every time is rough...
Isn't that a good thing, though？
Right？ I just like English songs. It doesn't mean I like English class.
Being praised doesn't feel bad, sure... but keeping up with expectations is hard.
Kobayakawa
There was a young, pretty woman in the staff room the other day. Guess who she was？
Hmm, I have no idea.
A former student of our head teacher's. Apparently she's coming here soon as a student teacher.
Being a teacher, huh... That actually sounds kind of nice.
You as a teacher, ▲小早川＊▲！？
You might make a good teacher.
...What？ I might actually make a good teacher, you know？ No homework, no tests. The students would love me.
I was only kidding... Besides, if I was a teacher, I couldn't skip class.
Kobayakawa
Why do we even have uniforms？ They're always nagging us about how long our skirts are.
That's the guidance teacher on your case, right？ I get that rules are rules, but they're way too picky.
That teacher hardly ever says anything to the boys.
Ugh, I wish we could just wear casual clothes to school. Don't you think？
Casual clothes would be nice.
I like the uniforms better.
Well, they're comfier. Plus, you'd get to see me in all kinds of outfits!
...Oh, so you have a fetish for them？ Please don't give me any weird looks, okay？
Kobayakawa
Lately, it seems like more students are making and bringing their own lunches.
Not happy about it, ▲小早川＊▲？
My favorite spot in the courtyard has been taken over by couples lately.
It's a rare spot where I can read in peace. They shouldn't be all lovey-dovey at school.
Cut 'em some slack at lunch？
Should we get all lovey-dovey too？
Hmm... Ugh, no way. It bugs me when people are lovey-dovey right next to me.
N-O! I hate feeling like we're just following the crowd. If it's because we want to, though, I wouldn't mind.
Kobayakawa
People trade notes a lot right before exams, don't they？
Oh, totally. I'll get copies of notes from the serious students.
Well, I have a friend who takes super neat, easy-to-read notes. I wonder if that's just a natural talent.
Who knows. Some people's notes are easier to understand than textbooks.
There's no way I could ever take notes like that.
It's fine if you can read them.
Why not try writing neater？
Oh, good point. As long as the notes I borrow are neat, that's all I need.
It's not like mine are messy now. Oh, why don't you kindly let me see your notes, too？ Just for reference. Come on.
Kobayakawa
My friend started a diet. She told me she's jealous that I don't need to go on one myself.
True, you love junk food, ▲小早川＊▲, but you never put on any weight at all.
Hmm, I don't do anything special. I wonder why everyone's so obsessed with it.
You probably shouldn't say that out loud.
Guess they just want to look as pretty as they can.
...Too late for that warning. I said it and got majorly chewed out. It's tough.
I don't think skinny equals pretty, though. What's the point of only working on the outside？ Right？
Kobayakawa
A friend of mine is upset because her boyfriend cheated. She doesn't want to break up, so she doesn't know what to do.
Hmm...
Her boyfriend apparently says men are just wired to cheat. You're not like that... are you？
Hard to say... Just kidding!
I will never cheat on you!
!? ...Want me to kick you？ No unfunny jokes allowed!
Good answer. Hehe... You're gonna stay by my side forever and ever, right？
Kobayakawa
Yesterday, my friend and I got into a little debate over the best potato chip flavor.
...You're arguing over stuff like that？
There's no way consomme is the best. Sea salt wins, hands down. The simplicity that brings out the natural flavor is what really matters.
I like all the flavors, really.
Your taste is niche, ▲小早川＊▲
Saying that kills the whole debate. Some things in this world have to be settled!
Hmm, you think so？ Guess the times just haven't caught up with me yet？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Do you think it's better to have a lot of friends？
Huh？ Did something happen？
Not really, it's just what people always say, right？ "Make lots of friends."
...Well, most adults do say that.
There are a few people I talk to a lot, but... I don't really get having "a lot."
Numbers alone don't mean much
I worry about that sometimes, too.
Right？ That's what I thought, too. If you say so, then I'm good.
Oh, really. That's kind of a relief. Even if we get worried, we're fine as long as we're not alone.
Kobayakawa
So I went to karaoke with my friends the other day. ...Ugh, seriously.
What's wrong？
I said we should do Western music only, and they shot me down.
...They probably didn't want to sing songs they don't know.
Even though it's a chance to discover great new music. Everyone's so conservative.
You're just a radical, ▲小早川＊▲
You should've just invited me instead.
Right. Culture is meant to be enjoyed actively. If you only listen to whatever drifts into your ears, your sensibilities will rot.
Yeah... There's a song I'm practicing... So once I get good at it, okay？
You look like you're in a good mood. Something happen？
Kobayakawa
I ran into a tough opponent at the arcade by the station.
Oh, in a fighting game.
And they're my age, too... Having a rival really makes me feel like I can get even stronger.
Sorry... I can't be a rival for you
Wait, is this rival a guy？
Look, I already know you're not perfect. All you need to be is the perfect boyfriend.
She's a girl, though？ Oh... My, my, is that what this is about？ Maybe a guy rival will show up too～？
Kobayakawa
I've gotten back into online auctions lately. They really get me pumped.
Online auctions, huh？ Sounds kind of fun.
It's all about the mind games. Kind of reminds me of playing a fighting game, actually.
What're you after right now？
What's your best prize so far？
A Killer Bambis bootleg... like, a pirated recording. ...Actually, never mind. It's not fair to the artist.
I got a pick used by the guitar god himself, God Mt.! The worn-down edge on it is just so raw and real～！
Kobayakawa
I've been going to the city library lately, and it's way better than I expected.
Makes sense. They've probably got more books than our school does.
It isn't just the sheer number. The selection is better, too.
Huh, really.
Lately, I've wanted to read fairy tales in the original language. They're hard to find at the school library.
Look at you, studying hard.
Fairy tales？ Didn't expect that.
I'm just doing it because I like it. I never really thought of it as studying.
I actually like fairy tales quite a bit, you know？
I just keep quiet so people don't get the wrong idea. Don't go telling anyone else.
Kobayakawa
My friend's boyfriend has been really into martial arts lately, apparently.
Then maybe you and he would have a lot to talk about, ▲小早川＊▲.
It's not like I'm a fan of martial arts or anything.
Even so, my friend got the wrong idea too, and asked us on a double date to a martial arts event.
Could be fun, right？
I'm worried you'll go wild, ▲小早川＊▲...
You think？ Forget the martial arts part... just the idea of a double date makes me kind of nervous.
I could always go wild right now, you know？ Here comes a kick.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Why are movies always the go-to date？
Isn't it because it gives you something to talk about？ Especially when you first start dating.
Hmm, safe answer. Okay then, what's the best movie for early on in a relationship？
A comedy for some big laughs!
A romance movie, obviously!
Good point. You want to keep the mood fun at first. Though if the movie's a dud, it's the worst.
Another safe answer. Kind of feels like you've got an ulterior motive, though. Not a fan.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, do you think a girlfriend should be girly, too？
Huh？ Did something happen？
My friend said her boyfriend told her that... so I wondered what you thought.
You're plenty girly too, ▲小早川＊▲.
They're them, and I'm me!
...If anyone else said that, I'd kick them and tell them to quit making stuff up.
But since it's you, I know you really get me when you say it... so I'm happy.
Right... Okay, good. I won't worry about it anymore!
Heard a new ice cream shop opened by the station. The girls in my class were making a big fuss about it.
Kobayakawa
Oh, I know that place! It's the one where they sing and dance while serving you, right？
Yeah, that's it. I kind of want to check it out.
I heard it's super popular and has a huge line, though？
Let's wait till the hype dies down.
All right, let's get in line!
Yeah. I don't really like jumping straight on trends anyway. If I have to wait for hours, I'd rather just buy ice cream at a convenience store.
Huh？ You'll line up for me？ Aw, thanks. ...I'm kidding. If we're together, even waiting in line might be fun.
Kobayakawa
My favorite dress got too tight on me. What a shock.
Hmm, that's a shame, but what can you do.
It's the one you complimented me on before. We had memories with it, too...
It's proof you're growing, so be happy!
Let's make new memories!
Well, I guess so. Even if I can't wear it, I can still keep it!
...You're seriously positive. Since you said it, you better follow through, okay？ I'm actually counting on it.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, do you know how to write a love letter？
Eh！？
A friend of mine wants to confess, but says she's too embarrassed to do it in person.
She should figure it out for herself.
In person is better, like you did, ▲小早川＊▲.
Right？ Yeah, I know. I was just asking in case. I'll tell her that after all.
!？ This isn't about me! ...You're such an idiot.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Did you know the arcade by the station got a new fighting game？
Hmm, no, I didn't.
Keep that up and you'll lose your spot as my boyfriend. Listen up. What's new is the guard cancel... Are you even listening？
I-I'm listening.
Hey. Do you hate fighting games or something？ If you don't like them, I'll stop talking about it...
I'm just not all that into them.
I like them, but you're getting way too technical...
True, it's probably no fun when you do nothing but lose to me.
All right, it's settled. Let's do some special training! Then you'll get more into it!
Oh, so you just need more practice. Fine then, I'll train you myself. For now, we're playing this new one nonstop.
Kobayakawa
We're doing the softball throw in PE. And my friend goes and says I probably can't throw it more than ten meters.
Even a grade schooler can throw farther than that...
Right？ Just because I'm bad at sports doesn't mean she can underestimate me like that. Now I really have to get serious.
Oh, rare to see you fired up!
Get a great score and show her!
Yeah, for once. Once I show her up, I'm going right back to slacking off like usual.
...When you put it like that, I'm starting to lose confidence. Hey... will you help me practice？
Kobayakawa
My mom's taking my little brother back to her parents' place for a little while. So in the heat of the moment, I declared I'd take care of all the housework myself.
Wait, can you even do that much housework, ▲小早川＊▲...？
...I probably can. Well, my dad says I don't have to do anything, though.
Your dad's right.
Take this chance to do some bridal training!
The way you said that kind of ticks me off. ...Still, maybe I'll start with the laundry or something. Cooking, though...
...Are you getting your hopes up or something？ Besides, don't you think 'bridal training' sounds kind of outdated？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hm？ What？
What's that all of a sudden？ Did I do something？
Nothing, really. I just figured if you had a guilty conscience, you might give yourself away.
...Just kidding, just kidding.
Hmm, on the second try, huh.
They say how many tries it takes you to say my name back shows how much you care. Not sure if it's true, though.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Say, have you ever wondered where your name came from？
Uh, well, let's see...
Come to think of it, I've never really thought about it.
I got curious and asked my parents about it once.
Huh. Is that just how guys are？
Hehe, tell me, then. What's the story？
▲小早川＊▲, try saying my name real quick.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Yeah, I'm so happy!
▲小早川＊▲！
Yeah, yeah. I figured as much.
Pretty nice of me to just say it without asking why, huh？ ▲主人公＊▲.
What's this, playing the sappy couple？ You like doing that sometimes. Is it a guy thing？
